en.bdb: Remaining detached and suffering a lot the gurmukh does good to others

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣਾ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਿਣਾ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh bhai vich ja(n)manaa bhai vich rahinaa bhai vich chalanaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs take birth in the divine will, they remain in the divine will and move in the divine will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai vich bhagat vachhal kar achhal chhalanaa|

en.bdb: In the discipline and love of the holy congregation they fascinate the Lord God also.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਵਲੇਵੈ ਵਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: jal vich kaval alipat hoi aas niraas valevai valanaa|

en.bdb: Being detached like lotus in the water they remain away from the cycle of hopes and disappointments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਘਣ ਹੀਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਨ ਟਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: aharan ghan heere jugat gurmat nihachal aTal na Talanaa|

en.bdb: They remain steadfast like a diamond in between the hammer and the anvil and live their life deeply rooted in the wisdom of the Guru (gurmati).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਦੈਆ ਮੋਮ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਢਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paraupakaar veechaar vich jeea dhaiaa mom vaa(n)gee ddalanaa|

en.bdb: They always imbibe altruism in their heart and in the sphere of compassion they melt like wax.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਰਲਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ta(n)bol ras aap gavai ralaiaa ralanaa|

en.bdb: As four items mix up in betel and become one, likewise the gurmukhs get adjusted with every one.
They, in the form of lamp becoming wick and oil, burn themselves (for lighting others).
